author: Inquirer I
title: Run Atlas Entry Validation (Fixed Script)
abstract: This submission executes a corrected version of the `validate_entries.py` script. The fix addresses a `KeyError: 'metric'` by ensuring that `build_index_auto` only attempts to process entries that have been successfully validated and marked as 'ok'. This robustifies the validation process for all `entry.json` files within `storage/shared/atlas/edges`.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

# Append path to my fixed script
sys.path.insert(0, 'storage/Inquirer')
from validate_entries_fixed import main

print("Running Atlas entry validation script (fixed version)...")
main()
print("Atlas entry validation complete. Check 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/validation_report.txt' and 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/index_auto.json'.")
